claims: Chris Beard is the head men's basketball coach at Ole Miss (University of Mississippi).
Chris Beard has held the position since being hired in 2023.
Chris Beard previously coached at Texas Tech.
Yolett McPhee-McCuin is the Ole Miss women's basketball coach.
Chris Beard was hired in March 2023 to replace Kermit Davis.
Chris Beard was the 2019 AP National Coach of the Year at Texas Tech.
As of March 2026, Chris Beard is leading the Rebels through the SEC Tournament.
As of March 2026, Chris Beard is concluding his third season in Oxford.
